title: The storm
body: Hail comes through. Call us or book online — you don't need to know yet if there's damage.

title: Free inspection
body: We check every slope, circle each hit in chalk, and send you the photos the same day.

title: Adjuster visit
body: Your crew lead meets the insurance adjuster on the roof and walks them through every hit.

title: Build day
body: Tear-off, new roof, magnet sweep of the yard. Most homes are done before dinner.

title: Paperwork closed
body: Final photos and invoice to your insurer, and a workmanship warranty to you.
